$comment: Prosary editorial translations of Maronite calendar display metadata from Evangelizo MAE, requested by the user. These labels are not liturgical prayers or Scripture and are not official church editions. Dates and ranks retain the MAE source identity; ordinary weekday season captions are omitted from feasts but their readings remain. Pentecost is rendered שבועות in Hebrew.
